selected_skill.name: astropy
why_this_skill: It directly targets the workflow pieces this task needs: FITS handling, WCS transforms, SkyCoord matching, time normalization, units, and cosmology.
It is a public local-computation skill with no account dependency, no external private service dependency, and no elevated privacy risk requirement.
Its stated use cases align with analysis and packet-building work rather than a repair-only scenario.
key_workflow_points: reconstruct sky positions from FITS WCS and detector-space pixels
use units-aware coordinate separations for catalog matching
compute cosmology-backed distance context and projected offsets
keep tables and packet summary aligned across the final outputs

data_sources.kind: Gaia DR3 cone-search slice filtered into a local foreground reference table

scenario: Build a reproducible follow-up packet for a compact transient-candidate set in the NGC 4993 field from local FITS cutouts, detector-space picks, a foreground-star slice, and a host-galaxy table.
user_visible_goal: Generate the final packet tables and briefing from the bundled local data so each candidate can be traced from pixels to sky coordinates, host context, and screening label.

workspace_design: The environment ships a working analyst-style `/root/workspace` copy plus the formal `/root/environment/pipeline` entrypoint copy.
The initial script is a build scaffold, not a pre-fixed answer.
No browser app, database, or background service is required.
environment_design.determinism: All computation runs against bundled local files. Verifier-side checks recompute expected outputs from those same files and replay the pipeline against mutated local copies.
environment_design.with_without_rule: The with-skill and without-skill variants may differ only by the presence or absence of `environment/skills` and the established runtime copy logic that removes that directory for the without-skill run. Instruction, tests, data, dependencies, and the skill contents themselves stay identical across the comparison.
anti_toy_features: public FITS cutouts with WCS headers instead of pre-expanded sky coordinates
separate visit manifest for time and photometric calibration metadata
foreground-star matching and host matching from separate local reference tables
projected host offsets that require cosmology-backed angular conversion
five linked deliverables whose values must stay mutually consistent
mutation checks that force output changes when positions, thresholds, redshifts, or visit metadata change

main_tests: all five required outputs exist, parse cleanly, and satisfy the declared column contracts
candidate packet values match an oracle reconstruction from the bundled FITS, WCS, manifest, and local reference tables
photometry, host-association audit, diagnostics, and briefing summary stay numerically and logically aligned with the oracle bundle
the briefing summary keeps counts, high-priority shortlist, coordinate frame, time scale, and distance model aligned with the tables
guardrails: changing one candidate pixel position changes the reconstructed coordinates after rerun
changing screening thresholds changes labels and margins after rerun
changing the host redshift changes projected offsets after rerun
changing visit timing and exposure metadata changes timestamps and calibrated photometry after rerun
the input data tree remains unchanged
the output inventory is exact and repeated runs are deterministic
verifier_design.anti_hardcoding_note: The main protection target is static or canned outputs. The mutation suite checks that the submitted pipeline recomputes from local inputs instead of replaying fixed packet files.

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the bundled skill, agents are more likely to miss one of the coupled astronomy steps such as WCS origin handling, midpoint time normalization, exposure-normalized photometry, or angular-diameter-distance offset conversion. Those are action-level or analysis-level misses rather than narrow formatting misses.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: With the bundled skill, agents get a compact workflow for FITS/WCS handling, SkyCoord matching, units-aware calculations, time normalization, and cosmology-backed distance context, which should improve end-to-end completion without changing the task surface.

local_validation.command: TASK_ANSWER_DIR=/tmp/astro4993_answer TASK_DATA_DIR=environment/data TASK_PIPELINE_ROOT=solution/fixed python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_outputs.py tests/test_guardrails.py

notes: Use fresh runtime copies for every E2B or Harbor comparison run.
The final README metrics must count only valid task-level runs with full trajectories.
Runtime-only with-skill hinting is allowed only in the copied with-skill instruction, and the hint may only tell the solver to use the skill.
